$comment: P4.D279 (the wardrobe keystone, C1 §2 / §4) — the round's ONE shared four-tier
seed. Consumers READ it, never change it. build-wardrobe-keystone-fixture.ts
bakes it into TWO databases (main + mount-index) through v4's REAL repos:
users:      A (owns Ada + the archived Zed) and B (owns Bo — the ownership
gate's otherUserId plant).
characters: Ada (live, user A; the vault every folder-writes op runs on),
Bo (live, user B), Zed (user A, ARCHIVED through
repos.characters.update({ archivedAt }) — the vault stays).
General:    the Quilltap General store (pinned id in MAIN instance_settings)
with two items.
projects:   Bare Manor — provisioned by create, NO Wardrobe/ folder (the R-C
GET-shaped probe: ensure:false finds the store and reads [],
ensure:true creates ONLY the folder);
Null Abbey — officialMountPointId NULLED after create (v4's REAL
repos.projects.findById THROWS ProjectStoreUnavailableError, so
both ensure arms throw and no store row is ever created);
Full Abbey — ensureOwnerOfficialStore + ensureSharedWardrobeFolder
+ two items via createMountWardrobeItem.
group:      Guild — Ada a member, official store, two items; one of them
carries the SAME id as Ada's archived own item (the shadow/unmask
case).
Ada's vault (every write through resolveWardrobeLocation(...).create):
a root item, a FILED item (Formal/Evening), an ARCHIVED own item,
a composite naming a General item's UUID (cross-tier ref kept);
PLUS a hand-made folder row Wardrobe/Hats: Summer, an EMPTY folder
row Wardrobe/Empty, a note Wardrobe/Notes/todo.md (no types) and a
.txt beside it, a text doc under the reserved Wardrobe/images/…,
and an id-less item file Wardrobe/Loose/no-id.md (frontmatter
without id: — the rename's stamp-before-move case).
scratch:    a pinned 'Projection Scratch' store pre-seeded for the recursive
projection family (a note, a half-written garment, a caption under
images/, instructions.md at two depths, three item files in two
folders, two flat Prompts/ files, the legacy wardrobe.json).
Minted ids (every vault / official-store mount point) are read back by both
sides from the owner rows; the three pinned store ids are General, the scratch
store and nothing else. Every item id and timestamp is pinned here.
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key (the one every harness
fixture uses). NOT the real Friday pepper; safe to commit.
